sentences.text:
This Criminal Petition Is Filed By The vs Unknown on 27
September, 2019
Author: M.Satyanarayana Murthy

Bench: M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 Criminal Petition No.4909 Of 2019
Order:

1. This criminal petition is filed by the petitioners/accused Nos.1 to 4 under Section 482 of Criminal Procedure Code (for short "Cr.P.C.") to quash the proceedings in Crime No.188 of 2019 pending on the file of Tenali II Town P.S, Guntur District registered for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273, 420 and 328 of Indian Penal Code (for short "I.P.C.") and Sections 57, 58, 59 and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 2.

entities.text: Tenali II Town P.S, Guntur District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor for the State, submit that the issue involved in this petition is squarely covered by the order of this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch dated 27.08.2018.
3. In view of the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor for the State, this criminal petition also stands allowed in terms of the said order.
Consequently, miscellaneous applications, pending if any, shall stand closed.
The Registry is directed to attach a copy of the order in Crl.P.No.3731 of 2018 and batch dated 27.08.2018 to this order.
_ JUSTICE M. SATYANARAYANA MURTHY 27.09.2019 Rvk This Criminal Petition Is Filed By The vs Unknown on 27 September, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/154089283/
